# Vaslix - AI Automation Agency

Vaslix is a B2B AI automation agency specializing in building custom business infrastructure.

## Core Services

- **AI WhatsApp Chatbots**: Smart assistants trained specifically for businesses to reply instantly, qualify leads, and book appointments. They include LLM integration, CRM syncing, voice note support, and multi-language capabilities.
- **AI Voice Calling Agents**: AI receptionists capable of handling inbound and outbound calls like a human, supporting multiple languages. They can book appointments, handle support, and sync with CRMs in real-time.
- **Premium 3D Websites & SaaS Platforms**: Futuristic, interactive 3D interfaces designed to help brands stand out. We provide ultra-fast performance, revenue-focused UX strategy, and AI-first integration.
- **Lead Generation & Data Scraping**: Highly targeted lead pipelines using email scraping, LinkedIn lead gen, and contact database building.
- **AI Content Systems**: Automated creation of social media content, ad creatives, and personalized marketing copy.
- **Meta Ads & AI Ad Creatives**: High-converting ad funnels maximizing ROAS with dynamic AI-generated visual assets and copy.
- **CRM Systems & Operations**: Custom tracking, team dashboards, automated reminders, and smart forecasting.
